I will do mostly what worked for me before. On this maize plot I will use a little chemical fertilizer if I can get it in time, and I will also put manure where I have it because this land is mine and I want it to keep producing. I will plant improved seed because I have seen some men nearby get better cobs with it, but I will not buy pesticide, and I will wait for the rains instead of irrigating. My family will do most of the work ourselves.
